provenance.method: Hand-written for structcorpus from the published yamlprims specification revision 1.3, sections 4, 5, and 8; each expected value is written out, not computed.

review.author: devlead
review.rationale: Hand-checked merge goldens with merge keys applied: precedence of explicit keys, source order, sequence sources, malformed and repeated directives, and quoted or string-tagged '<<'. Bound to the revision 1.3 profile; expectations are identical to the revision 1.1 recipe because no input in this set is affected by 1.2/E-1 to E-3 or 1.3/E-1 to E-4.
